name: Red smoke
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: Red smoke was released on January 28th, 2022, for purchase in a special bundle only available until the 7th of February 2022.
It could be purchased as part of a larger bundle costing 19 990 . The bundle was named "Red Envelope" and apart from the paint, also came with 300x Ultra Containers, and 3x Nuclear Energy supplies.
It became available into containers as legendary rarity since 1st August, 2025
